questions.text: What would happen if your own life was treated with the same care you offer everyone else?
Where does all the quiet fury go when you decide to keep the peace for everyone around you?
How do you carry the weight of a duty that no one ever actually asked if you were willing to bear?
What might shift if having human limits made you gentle with yourself instead of disappointed?
Who taught you that speaking your truth would cause everyone else to completely fall apart?
What makes your existence feel so easily packed up and reassigned by the people in your family?
What does it feel like to finally say out loud that your life and your presence actually count?
What becomes possible when you imagine a single day that belongs entirely and only to you?
